data.question_intent: Inquire about the impact of Pillar 2 offset on CET1 ratio target and future customer activity in response to the budget.

It's probably too early, but anything you can provide in terms of quantum and does that potentially even change your 13% to 14% [CET1] ratio target?
data.answer_quote: Okay. Thank you, Andy. So really too early to say.
